exposure: Location of inpatient monitoring for vasa previa (remote from labor and delivery vs. standard/outpatient)
Resolution status of vasa previa (resolved vs. persistent)
outcome: Neonatal anemia related to vasa previa
cohort: The cohort consisted of 50 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with vasa previa at a single institution.
finding: Monitoring patients with vasa previa in an antepartum unit located remotely from labor and delivery was not associated with adverse pregnancy or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No difference was found in urgent or emergent cesarean deliveries between patients managed outpatient versus inpatient.
gest_age: Vasa previa was diagnosed at a median gestational age of 22.9 weeks (range 18.0-34.3); inpatient admission occurred at a median of 31.2 weeks (range 25.6-34.3).
